## Breaking Changes
FastAPI 0.100.0 introduces support for Pydantic v2. Pydantic v1 is still supported via pydantic.v1 compatibility module. Upgraded starlette dependency.

## Security Fixes
Fix ReDoS vulnerability in multipart form data parsing (CVE-2024-24762). Ensure upload headers do not consume infinite backtrack regex.

## Breaking Changes
Drop support for older Starlette versions. Starlette >= 0.36.0 is now required. Async APIRoute handlers require return annotations for strict response models.

## Breaking Changes
Pydantic V2 core is rewritten in Rust. Deprecated BaseModel.dict() in favor of BaseModel.model_dump(). Removed BaseModel.parse_obj() in favor of BaseModel.model_validate(). Config inner class replaced by ConfigDict.

## Features and Deprecations
Added support for typing.Self. Deprecated regex argument in Field; use pattern instead. Improved json_schema generation.

## Breaking Changes
Strict boolean coercion changes. Strings like 'yes' or '1' are no longer coerced to True when strict=True. Added FailFast validation mode.

## Release 0.1.0 Architecture
Split core package into langchain-core and langchain-community. Deprecated monolithic langchain imports.

## Breaking Changes
LLMChain is officially deprecated. Users must transition to LangChain Expression Language (LCEL) pipelines using pipe operators: prompt | llm. Deprecated initialize_agent in favor of create_tool_calling_agent.

## Fixes and Improvements
Streamlined message parsing in ChatGoogleGenerativeAI and ChatOpenAI. Fixed serialization of tool calls in BaseModel payload.

## Architecture Overhaul
Chroma 0.4.0 introduces unified PersistentClient and HttpClient. Removed clickhouse and duckdb+parquet backends in favor of SQLite and local HNSW segments.

## Changes
Added where_document operators $contains and $not_contains. Deprecated raw dict settings in chromadb.Client(Settings()).

## Breaking Changes
Removed chroma_db_impl configuration key completely. Client creation now requires chromadb.PersistentClient(path=...) or chromadb.HttpClient().

Security Advisory: GHSA-fastapi-mock-1 (CVE-2024-24762)
Package: fastapi (PyPI)
Severity: HIGH
Fixed in: 0.109.1
Summary: Form data parsing ReDoS vulnerability in FastAPI multipart processing.

Security Advisory: GHSA-langchain-cve-2023-36258 (CVE-2023-36258)
Package: langchain (PyPI)
Severity: CRITICAL
Fixed in: 0.0.210
Summary: Arbitrary code execution via unsafe python exec in PALChain and PythonAstREPLTool.
